map.水电（读数/周期）结算 使用指南: Utility Reading and Billing Settlement Guide
map.按读数结算水电燃气费用：末档不设上限，空读数和读数倒退会被拦截，换表可勾选后从: Settle utility charges from readings: the top tier is unlimited, blank or backward readings are blocked, and a meter replacement can be ticked to restart from 0.
map.记录水电燃气读数并按阶梯或单一费率结算；末档不设上限、支持换表与计费周期累计，空: Record utility readings and settle by tiered or flat rates; the top tier is unlimited, meter replacement and billing-period accumulation are supported, and blank or backward readings block settlement.
map.选择电费/水费/燃气费，配置单一单价或阶梯档位；阶梯上限须严格递增、单价非负。: Choose electricity, water or gas and configure a flat price or tier limits; tier limits must strictly increase and prices must be non-negative.
map.填写每次抄表日期与读数；换表行勾选「换表」。: Enter each reading date and value; tick Meter replacement on a replacement row.
map.选择阶梯累计周期：每次区间独立套档或整个结算周期累计。: Choose the tier accumulation period: each reading interval separately, or the whole settlement period.
map.点「计算结算」，查看各段用量、费用与阶梯明细；空读数或倒退会列出具体行。: Click Calculate settlement to see usage, charges and tier details for each segment; blank or backward readings list the exact row.
map.退租或换租时按上次/本次读数结算。: Settle at move-out or tenant change using the previous and current readings.
map.阶梯电量超过原末档上限时，核对超出部分是否仍计费。: When tiered usage exceeds the old top limit, check that the excess is still charged.
map.电表更换后按新表从 0 起算，避免把倒退读数记成 0。: After a meter replacement, count from 0 on the new meter instead of turning a backward reading into 0.
map.330 kWh 与超过末档上限: 330 kWh and exceeding the top tier
map.12 450 → 12 780，用电 330 kWh。单一价 0.60：330×: 12,450 → 12,780 gives 330 kWh. At a flat 0.60: 330×0.60 = 198.00 CNY. Tiers 0–200 at 0.55 and 200–600 at 0.63: 200×0.55 + 130×0.63 = 191.90 CNY. For 700 kWh with an unlimited top tier from 600: 200×0.55 + 400×0.63 + 100×0.83 = 445.00 CNY, so the last 100 kWh is not missed.
map.读数倒退默认阻止结算，勾选「换表」才按新表从 0 起算；空读数不再保存为 0；整: A backward reading blocks settlement by default; only a ticked Meter replacement restarts from 0. Blank readings are no longer saved as 0. In period accumulation, charges are allocated by usage share and noted in the report.
map.读数倒退怎么办？: What if a reading goes backward?
map.先更正读数；确为换表则勾选该行「换表」，按新表从 0 起算。: Correct the reading first; if the meter really changed, tick Meter replacement on that row and count from 0.
map.阶梯按区间还是整周期？: Are tiers applied per interval or per period?
map.可在「阶梯累计周期」选择；整周期累计会先对总用量套档再按比例分摊。: Choose under Tier accumulation period; whole-period accumulation applies tiers to total usage, then allocates proportionally.
map.空读数会记 0 吗？: Is a blank reading treated as 0?
map.不会，空读数会阻止结算并提示补填或删除该行。: No; it blocks settlement and asks you to fill or delete the row.
